To complete Completion of INC/Removal – Online System, follow the steps below.

Requirements:
- Completion form Registrar Proof of Payment for completion/removal (official Cashier 86 receipt)

Steps:
1. After submitting the complete requirements to the subject teacher, the students will log in to his portal in LSPU online system to apply online for the completion of INC or 4.0 grade. The student will pay the corresponding completion fess to the cashier’s office
2. After receiving the student’s payment, the cashier will put the OR number on the completion form of the student through the online system
3. The student will inform the subject teacher that he already applied for online completion of his
4. The subject teacher will give the corresponding grades through the online system
5. INC/4.0 grade. The registrar will check if the INC or 4.0 grade is changed
6. Upon checking the completion grade given by the subject dean or associate dean shall approve the request for completion/removal

Office: College, Registrar, Cashier
Processing Time: 25 minutes
Fee: P30.00

Source: Laguna State Polytechnic University-CC_2026-1st Edition, Completion of INC/Removal – Online System, page 94
